strings.setup.network.detected.title: Detected on this computer
strings.setup.network.knowledge.label: DMT information
strings.setup.network.knowledge.disclaimer: The technical data above comes from Windows. This explanation comes from DMT's local knowledge base and never replaces the detected facts.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rpc.title: Windows Remote Procedure Call (RPC)
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rpc.body: A core Windows communication mechanism used by many system services and applications. TCP 135 is commonly used by the RPC Endpoint Mapper. Its presence is normal on Windows; do not disable it just because it is listening.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.smb.title: Windows file and printer sharing (SMB)
strings.setup.network.knowledge.smb.body: TCP 445 is normally used by SMB for Windows file, printer and administrative sharing. Whether it should be reachable depends on the network and firewall policy.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.lms.title: Intel Local Management Service
strings.setup.network.knowledge.lms.body: LMS is commonly installed with Intel management components and provides local communication with Intel management firmware/features. DMT reports the listener but does not assume that the component is required on this PC.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rdp.title: Remote Desktop Services
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rdp.body: TCP 3389 is the standard listener for Microsoft Remote Desktop when RDP is enabled. Exposure should match the intended remote-access policy.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.winrm.title: Windows Remote Management
strings.setup.network.knowledge.winrm.body: WinRM provides standards-based remote management for Windows. It commonly uses TCP 5985 for HTTP and 5986 for HTTPS. It should be enabled and exposed only where required.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.dropbox.title: Dropbox local listener
strings.setup.network.knowledge.dropbox.body: This listener belongs to the Dropbox process. DMT can identify the process and its exposure, but does not infer an undocumented purpose for this specific port. A loopback binding is reachable only from this computer.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.unknown.title: No specific explanation yet
strings.setup.network.knowledge.unknown.body: DMT does not have a specific entry for this listener yet. The detected process, service, executable path, publisher and exposure above are still useful facts for identifying it.
